control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report - thermal exposure at TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-3002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-3002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 5 March 2012 a hazard report was recorded on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
